_about: Step 5 talk-to-data chat. enabled = the native chat exists for businesses (the v51 external link in settings.json -> talk_to_data is used only when this is off). max_question_chars: longer questions are refused before any work. history_days: conversations are deleted this many days after their last message (a person can delete earlier); also ASK_CHAT_DAYS in report_store.py. rate: per person per minute / hour and per business per day - past them the person gets a clear message, not an answer (this protects the AI budget from loops). The monthly allowance of AI-answered questions is the plan's ask_per_month (config/report_plans.json); credits (config/ai_credits.json, feature talk_to_data) apply when credit mode is 'enforce'. When either is used up, questions are still answered, by rules, with a note. starters: example questions shown on an empty chat (they must be questions the benchmark answers well). deeper: texts of the 'Go deeper' button (see inside). prewarm: the common questions run once in the background when someone opens the chat (per business and data version) so the first real question is fast; [] or removing it switches it off.

en: How much revenue did I make last month?
Why did revenue change compared with the previous period?
Which weekday is my best day?
vi: Tháng trước tôi bán được bao nhiêu doanh thu?
Sản phẩm nào bán chạy nhất?
Vì sao doanh thu thay đổi so với kỳ trước?
Tôi nên lo ngại điều gì?
Thứ nào trong tuần bán tốt nhất?
de: Wie viel Umsatz habe ich letzten Monat gemacht?
Welche Produkte verkaufen sich am besten?
Warum hat sich der Umsatz gegenüber dem Vorzeitraum verändert?
Worüber sollte ich mir Sorgen machen?
Welcher Wochentag ist mein bester Tag?

deeper._about: 'Go deeper' button: the next question after an answer, by what the last answer was made of. metric = one number / comparison / trend, breakdown = a split or ranking, explain = why-it-changed. Every text must be a question the planner answers (they are in the benchmark).
